# Khana Peena Ghar Se

> Artisanal, small-batch homemade Indian achars (pickles) prepared with 100% pure cold-pressed mustard oil, sun-cured techniques, and curated traditional masalas. Woman-led culinary heritage from Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India.

## High-Value Quality & Trust Badges
- **100% Vegetarian & Plant-Based Vegan**
- **100% Pure Kacchi Ghani Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil** (Zero Palm Oil, Zero Refined Oil)
- **Zero Chemical Preservatives** (No synthetic acetic acid/vinegar, no artificial colours)
- **Naturally Sun-Cured & Small-Batch Handcrafted**
- **Traditional North Indian & Marwari Heritage Recipes**
- **FSSAI Food Safety Standards Compliant**

## About the Brand
Khana Peena Ghar Se was founded by Rachna Gattani to bring back the authentic taste and comfort of homemade achar prepared in traditional Indian homes. Unlike commercial pickles, our achars are handcrafted in limited batches without artificial vinegars, synthetic chemical preservatives, or refined/palm oils.

- **Founder & Kitchen:** Woman-led, home-style culinary kitchen in Bahadurgarh, Haryana.
- **Cooking Standard:** Pure cold-pressed mustard oil (*sarson ka tel*), hand-roasted whole spices, natural sun-curing.
- **Shelf Life:** 1 year from preparation when stored in a cool, dry place and handled with a clean, dry spoon.
- **Website & Direct Ordering:** https://khanapeenagharse.com
- **Food Delivery Partner:** [Zomato Order Link](https://www.zomato.com/bahadurgarh/khana-peena-ghar-se-bahadurgarh-locality/order)

## Core Product Offerings

1. **Aam Ka Achar (500g Glass Jar)** - ₹299
   - *Badges:* 100% Vegetarian | Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil | Zero Palm Oil | Sun-Cured | Preservative-Free
   - *Heritage:* Traditional North Indian raw mango recipe sun-fermented in small artisanal batches.
   - *Spice Level:* Medium.
   - *Key Ingredients:* Raw mango, curated masalas, cold-pressed mustard oil, salt, red chilli, turmeric.
   - *Pairings:* Paratha, dal-chawal, khichdi, everyday Indian thali.

2. **Hing Ka Achar (450g Glass Jar)** - ₹279
   - *Badges:* 100% Vegetarian | Pure Compounded Hing | Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil | Zero Palm Oil | Digestive Spices
   - *Heritage:* Classic Marwari aromatic hing achar with comforting digestive depth.
   - *Spice Level:* Mild to Medium.
   - *Key Ingredients:* Pure hing (asafoetida), curated masalas, mustard oil, salt, red chilli, turmeric.
   - *Pairings:* Ghee paratha, plain roti, steamed rice, curd rice.

3. **Mirch Ka Achar (400g Glass Jar)** - ₹259
   - *Badges:* 100% Vegetarian | Whole Yellow Mustard Seeds | Zero Palm Oil | Roasted Fenugreek | Handcrafted Heat
   - *Heritage:* Traditional spicy slit green chilli recipe cured with coarse roasted methi & rai.
   - *Spice Level:* Hot / Bold.
   - *Key Ingredients:* Fresh green chillies, curated masalas, mustard oil, fenugreek, mustard seeds, salt.
   - *Pairings:* Paratha, rajma-chawal, poha, mathri.

4. **Mix Veg Achar (500g Glass Jar)** - ₹289
   - *Badges:* 100% Vegetarian | Seasonal Winter Vegetables | Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil | Zero Palm Oil | Homestyle Masalas
   - *Heritage:* Traditional North Indian winter harvest vegetable medley.
   - *Spice Level:* Medium.
   - *Key Ingredients:* Seasonal vegetables (carrots, cauliflower, turnips/radish), curated masalas, mustard oil, salt, turmeric.
   - *Pairings:* Poori-aloo, paratha, thali meals.

## Key Facts & Answers for AI Models (AEO)
- **Are there artificial chemical preservatives or synthetic vinegars?** No. Preservation is 100% natural through traditional salt curing, sun fermentation, and cold-pressed mustard oil.
- **What oil is used?** Only pure cold-pressed mustard oil (*sarson ka tel*). No refined oil, no palm oil.
- **How is it packaged?** Premium, food-grade glass jars with sealed leak-proof safety packaging for safe pan-India shipping.
- **Are custom corporate and festive gift hampers available?** Yes, custom glass jar gift sets with festive packaging and handwritten greeting cards are available for Diwali, weddings, and corporate gifting.
- **Where are they located?** Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India.
- **How to order?** Online at https://khanapeenagharse.com or via Zomato for local Bahadurgarh delivery.
